assumptions.choice: Default vol_threshold set to 0.0 using 20-period SMA of volume.
assumptions.reason: The specification mentions ignoring signals if volume over N candles does not exceed a threshold. Setting default to 0.0 avoids filtering out liquid assets like AAPL unless configured.

assumptions.choice: 1% of total capital (pct_capital=0.01) converted to shares, floored at minimum 1 share if cash permits.
assumptions.reason: With $10,000 starting cash and asset prices above $100, 1% ($100) yields 0 shares under integer division. Enforcing a minimum of 1 share ensures trade execution while honoring capital allocation intent.
Bollinger Bands with devfactor=2.0 span exactly 2 standard deviations above and below the middle line, making (top - mid) / 2.0 mathematically exact.

assumptions.choice: Evaluated both dynamic middle line crossing (close price relative to current boll.mid) and static take-profit level set at entry point.
assumptions.reason: The specification mentions crossing the middle line as an exit condition and also explicitly states setting take-profit at the level of the middle line from the entry point. Supporting both ensures full compliance with both statements.

assumptions.choice: Checked len(self) < 200 at start of next() before trading.
assumptions.reason: The spec requires ensuring at least 200 candles of historical data are collected before trading begins.
